source.rule: reported value preferred; imputed value used only when reported is missing

scope: 32 species already identified as continuity carriers; this audit tests recurrence among carriers, not carrier-vs-noncarrier probability.
interpretation: Carrier recurrence is not associated strongly with body mass, natal dispersal, habitat breadth, diet breadth or home-range size in this 32-species carrier-only audit. Population density shows the largest positive association and effect size, making local/common abundance and repeated spatial prevalence a stronger next mechanism hypothesis than broad niche generalism or mobility.
claim_boundary: COMBINE density is a species-level literature trait, not local NEON site density.
The sample includes carriers only, so the analysis cannot identify causes of carrier versus non-carrier status.
Trait comparisons are post hoc exploratory and are not confirmatory tests.
Phylogenetic non-independence is not corrected in this small carrier-only diagnostic.
